children: The Treasury Department said that it will buy up to $6 billion in 20- to 30-year Treasury bonds during its buyback operation later on Thursday.
The Treasury said in August it would increase the size of its buybacks on longer-dated securities to at least $4 billion over the next quarter in an effort to support liquidity.
